package.description: The Wii Balance Board Device Enabler for LabChart facilitates communication between a Nintendo Wii Balance Board and LabChart over a wireless Bluetooth connection.

en-US.description: The Wii Balance Board Device Enabler for LabChart facilitates communication between a Nintendo Wii Balance Board and LabChart over a wireless Bluetooth connection.
en-US.longDescription: The Wii Balance Board Device Enabler for LabChart facilitates communication between a Nintendo Wii Balance Board and LabChart over a wireless Bluetooth connection. Data from four load sensors within the board can be streamed into LabChart with each sensor's data mapped to a separate LabChart channel. Combining channel data in LabChart allows for measurements such as a person's weight or center of balance.
en-US.name: ADInstruments Wii Balance Board

zh-CN.description: Wii 平衡板设备启用器（LabChart 专用）实现了任天堂 Wii 平衡板与 LabChart 软件间的无线蓝牙通信。
zh-CN.longDescription: Wii 平衡板设备启用器（LabChart 专用）实现了任天堂 Wii 平衡板与 LabChart 软件间的无线蓝牙通信。该平衡板内置的四个压力传感器数据可实时传输至 LabChart，每个传感器的读数均对应独立的软件通道。通过整合多通道数据，LabChart 可进行人体重量测量及重心平衡分析等计算。
